Definition: What proportion of land ownership does the register cover?
Comments: Substantial operational uptake within project areas: 469,000 parcels assigned NICAD (as of 21-Nov-2025), but not yet universal national coverage.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Revised down substantially. The cited PROCASEF supervision report measures progress against project targets in a limited set of pilot municipalities, not national coverage. Nationally representative data show the opposite: the World Bank's 2022-23 Annual Agricultural Survey finds 97.3% of surveyed parcels have no registered land document, and World Bank appraisal/gender studies describe the 'vast majority' of Senegalese land as unregistered National Domain land, with 92% of men and 89% of women in surveyed rural communes holding no formal land right. This points to national coverage well under 20%, not 50-69%.

redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Revised up. Senegalese press (Dakaractu, Equonet, 22 Mar 2024) confirm an operational DGD-DGID data-interconnection platform ('banque de données fiscales') actively used to cross-check customs and tax data, formalised by a March 2024 automated-data-exchange protocol, building on a NINEA-sharing interconnection between ANSD, DGD, DGID, DGF and DGCPT dating to 2014. This is real, working technical integration across multiple administrations, beyond merely 'Planned'; 'Partially integrated' (4) is a better fit.

Definition: Does the register manage income tax, business taxes or both?
Comments: DGID platforms support declarations and payments for various taxes and filing of financial statements (SEN-ETAFI), indicating broad scope across taxpayer obligations.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Revised up. DGID's 'Mon Espace Perso' platform is explicitly open to individual citizens as well as smaller businesses for online personal income-tax declaration and payment ('tout citoyen peut faire sa déclaration d'impôt en ligne'), while eTax/SEN-ETAFI serve larger corporate taxpayers. This shows the digital tax register manages both income and business taxpayers, not business taxpayers only.
